title: Blibli Affiliate Link Generator & Content Parser

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to source products from, e.g. ["laptop gaming", "skincare"]. Combine with the quality filters below to surface only products worth promoting.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Blibli category codes or full category URLs, e.g. ["TI-1000001"] or ["https://www.blibli.com/c3/memory-card/ME-1000006"].

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: How Blibli orders the source list. 'bestSelling' is the default and what most affiliate sourcing wants.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only products rated at least this many stars. Pushed to Blibli's own rating filter where possible, then enforced exactly on each product's real rating. 0 disables.

minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count
minReviewCount.description: Skip products with too few reviews for the rating to mean anything. 0 disables.

minDiscountPercent.title: Minimum discount %
minDiscountPercent.description: Keep only products discounted by at least this much - a discount makes a far better post. Pushed to Blibli's discount facet (buckets of 10/25/50/75) and then enforced exactly. 0 disables.

officialWarrantyOnly.title: Official warranty only (Garansi Resmi)
officialWarrantyOnly.description: Restrict to products carrying an official manufacturer warranty - the 'produk orisinal bergaransi resmi' filter. Applied server-side by Blibli.

officialStoreOnly.title: Official stores only
officialStoreOnly.description: Keep only products sold by an official brand store, which are the safest to promote.

topRatedSellerOnly.title: Top-rated sellers only
topRatedSellerOnly.description: Restrict to sellers Blibli marks as top rated.

generateShareLink.title: Generate Blibli share link
generateShareLink.description: Mint Blibli's own OneLink short link (blibli.onelink.me/...) for each product, carrying your tracking values. Costs one extra request per product. NOTE: this is a tracking/deep link, not a commission link - see the actor README on what Blibli's affiliate commission API requires.

trackingCampaign.title: Tracking campaign (utm_campaign)
trackingCampaign.description: Stamped onto every link as utm_campaign. This is where your affiliate or creator ID goes, e.g. 'aff-yourname-sep2026'.

trackingSource.title: Tracking source (utm_source)
trackingSource.description: Stamped onto every link as utm_source, e.g. 'instagram', 'tiktok', 'blog'.

trackingMedium.title: Tracking medium (utm_medium)
trackingMedium.description: Stamped onto every link as utm_medium, e.g. 'social', 'bio-link', 'newsletter'.

captionTemplate.title: Caption template
captionTemplate.description: Ready-to-post caption built for every product. Placeholders: {name} {brand} {price} {listPrice} {discount} {rating} {reviewCount} {sold} {warranty} {description} {link} {merchant}. Leave empty to skip caption generation.

enrichFromProductPage.title: Enrich from product page
enrichFromProductPage.description: Open each product page to add the exact warranty statement (e.g. 'Garansi resmi 2 tahun'), Blibli's own SEO description, and stock. Costs one extra request per product but is the only way to get the warranty wording - search results do not carry it.

imageSize.title: Image size
imageSize.description: Which image variant to return. 'full' is best for posts.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max products per query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Stop after this many qualifying products per search term or category. 0 means no limit (Blibli serves at most 800 per query).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel link-minting and enrichment requests. Keep low to stay under Blibli's rate limiting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Blibli is behind Cloudflare and throttles sustained traffic from one IP. Apify Residential proxy with country 'ID' is strongly recommended here.
